title: PM Modi — Andhra Pradesh visit: airport + South India's first chip plant
summary: Inaugurated Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport, Bhogapuram (₹5,000–5,640 Cr PPP — sources vary slightly) and laid foundation of AP's/South India's first semiconductor manufacturing facility.

blocks.content: Inaugurated Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport, Bhogapuram (₹5,000–5,640 Cr PPP — sources vary slightly) and laid foundation of AP's/South India's first semiconductor manufacturing facility.

items: **ASIP Technologies'** ₹2,500 crore (one source cites ₹460 Cr) OSAT facility, Visakhapatnam, AP — first semiconductor plant in South India under India Semiconductor Mission (ISM 1.0); tech partner: South Korea's APACT Co
(Cost figures for both the airport and the chip plant differ slightly between source PDFs — flagging for verification; core "firsts" are consistent across both)
